compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Implement classify-bug-at-closure.sh. Make T1 tests pass.

## Interface
classify-bug-at-closure.sh <ticket-id> <reason-prefix>
  Where reason-prefix is the first word of the --reason string (e.g., 'Fixed:' or 'Escalated to user:')

## Behavior
- If reason-prefix does NOT start with 'Fixed:': exit 0 silently (skip)
- If reason-prefix starts with 'Fixed:':
  1. Load registry slugs from bug-classification-registry.json
  2. Run bug-classifier-haiku dispatch (guidance: read agent prompt, build prompt, call agent; OR use CLASSIFIER_OUTPUT env var for testing)
  3. Validate output (byte-exact against slug set ∪ uncategorized)
  4. On valid: ticket tag <id> bug-type-<slug>
  5. On schema/timeout/error: ticket tag <id> bug-type-uncategorized; ticket tag <id> bug-type-classifier-failed-<reason>
  6. Retry tag writes once; on second failure post comment
- Respect TICKET_CMD and CLASSIFIER_OUTPUT env vars for testability

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-classify-bug-at-closure.sh exits 0.
